channel.title: World Health Organization (WHO) – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from World Health Organization (WHO) – Bias and Credibility (kff.org)

item.title: The President's Malaria Initiative and Other U.S. Government Global Malaria Efforts | KFF
item.description: This fact sheet provides a snapshot of global malaria efforts and examines the U.S. government’s role in addressing malaria worldwide, including current programs, funding, and key issues.

item.title: 10 Things to Know About Medicaid Managed Care | KFF
item.description: Our updated explainer provides an overview of comprehensive managed care, the most common way states deliver Medicaid services to enrollees.

item.title: What to Know About the BALANCE Model for GLP-1s in Medicare and Medicaid | KFF
item.description: This brief describes current coverage of GLP-1s in Medicare and Medicaid, the Centers for Medicare &amp; Medicaid Services’ (CMS) efforts to expand access and lower costs for GLP-1s through temporary demonstration programs including the BALANCE Model, and potential impacts on beneficiaries and program budgets.

item.title: Claims Denials and Appeals in ACA Marketplace Plans in 2024 | KFF
item.description: This brief analyzes federal transparency data published by CMS on claims denials and appeals for Marketplace plan offered on HealthCare.gov in 2024, and finds insurers denied 19% of in-network claims. Consumers rarely appeal denied claims.

item.title: KFF Tracker: America First MOU Bilateral Global Health Agreements | KFF
item.description: This tracker provides up-to-date information on countries with signed bilateral MOU global health agreements with the U.S.

item.title: LGBT People Experience Widespread Concerns and Challenges When it Comes to Health Care Affordability | KFF
item.description: This analysis highlights the health care affordability challenges facing LGBT adults, a growing population that faces health related disparities. Findings from KFF Health Tracking Polls show that LGBT adults face more widespread concerns with affording basic necessities, including health care, compared to non-LGBT adults.

item.title: One or Two Health Systems Controlled the Entire Market for Inpatient Hospital Care in Nearly Half of Metropolitan Areas in 2024 | KFF
item.description: This analysis examines the competitiveness of markets for hospital care and finds that nearly half of metropolitan areas across the country had only one or two hospitals or health systems providing general inpatient hospital care in 2024.

item.title: U.S. Global Health Country-Level Funding Tracker | KFF
item.description: This tracker provides U.S. global health funding data by program area and country. It will be updated as new data become available.

item.title: Medicaid Enrollment and Unwinding Tracker | KFF
item.description: This tracker presents the most recent Medicaid data on renewals and disenrollments available for each state as well as monthly enrollment data during the unwinding period.

item.title: Tracking Implementation of the 2025 Reconciliation Law: Medicaid Work Requirements Data and Policies | KFF
item.description: Detailed state and national data related to the 2025 Reconciliation Law Medicaid Work Requirements

item.title: Public Opinion on Prescription Drugs and Their Prices | KFF
item.description: This chart collection draws on recent KFF poll findings to provide an in-depth look at the public's attitudes toward prescription drugs and their prices. Results include the U.S. public’s experiences with prescription drug costs, use of GLP-1 medications, and support for policy solutions.

item.title: How Does U.S. Life Expectancy Compare to Other Countries? | KFF
item.description: This chart collection examines how life expectancy in the U.S. compares to that of other similarly large and wealthy countries. Life expectancy at birth in the U.S. increased 0.6 years from 78.4 years in 2023 to 79.0 years in 2024, its highest-ever level. However, the average life expectancy in comparable countries was 82.7 years, about 3.7 years longer than in the U.S., reflecting a persistently wide difference in life expectancy between the U.S. and comparable countries.

item.title: Overview of President Trump’s Executive Actions on Global Health | KFF
item.description: This guide provides an overview of executive orders and other executive actions made by the Trump Administration since January 21, 2025 that directly address or affect U.S. global health efforts. This resource identifies each executive action, describes its purpose and actions taken, and outlines the implications and what happens next for each. The resource will be updated as needed.

item.title: Global COVID-19 Tracker | KFF
item.description: This tracker provides data on global COVID-19 cases and deaths by country, region, and income-level. Additionally, the tracker reports current closure, economic, and health system policy responses to the COVID-19 pandemic globally. This tracker will be updated as new data are available.

item.title: KFF Health Tracking Poll: The Public’s View of Immigration Enforcement Activities in Health Care Settings | KFF
item.description: Amid reports of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) at hospitals and President Trump's reversal of policy protecting "sensitive locations" like hospitals, KFF's Health Tracking Poll finds that a majority of the public say they are concerned about the Trump administration's actions in health care settings.
